newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones average gains more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones average gains more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average rose more than 50 points in afternoon trading Friday as investors shrugged off a sluggish bond market after the government reported a sharp drop in unemployment in April.
At 2:25 p.m, EDT, the Dow was up 50.17 points at 7,026.65, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limit on program trading.
